name: The Savior of Kalimdor
label: Quest
description: The Savior of Kalimdor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To the Caverns of Time you go, Friend friend. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Master has left these for you, champion. From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.
